meta.description: Runs KEGG ORA, GSEA, reproducible gson snapshots, signed SPIA topology analysis, condition comparison, and pathview overlays in R.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: Scores and pathway counts are explicitly identified as fresh synthetic/live-service audit output; no biomedical finding was fabricated.

practice_boundaries.detail: The Skill analyzes pathway statistics and does not diagnose, triage, or prescribe for an individual.

methodological_ground.detail: The Skill distinguishes ORA, ranked GSEA, and signaling-only topology; it requires matching IDs, measured universes, seeds, multiple-testing adjustment, and KEGG snapshots.

code_usability.detail: Both shipped examples parsed and all seven isolated-runtime inputs completed with exit 0. The graphite bootstrap knob propagation defect is a P1 usability issue, not a syntax/dependency failure.

functional_suitability.note: Covers KEGG pathway/module ORA, ranked GSEA, gson pinning, topology, multi-condition comparison, bacterial IDs, and map overlays.

reliability.note: Excellent ID/universe/seed/live-data safeguards, but the graphite route silently ignores the exposed n_boot setting.

performance_context.note: The long topology cost is disclosed, but the script's interactive control is not forwarded to graphite, which instead takes SPIA's 2,000-bootstrap default.

agent_usability.note: Decision tree, explicit arguments, expected failures, and reference routing are strong; one central runtime knob is ineffective for half of the topology workflow.

human_usability.note: Readable scenario table and focused references make advanced pathway choices approachable.

security.note: No credential handling, destructive commands, or untrusted-code execution are documented.

maintainability.note: Version block, references, and examples are well organized, but the duplicated conceptual bootstrap setting was not kept in sync with the graphite call.

agent_specific.note: Trigger description, scope boundaries, and escape hatches are precise; the topology runtime control should be made operational.

key_strengths: Fresh private-runtime tests covered each advertised KEGG workflow, including gson pinning, prokaryotic IDs, topology, comparison, and image rendering.
The Skill clearly separates live KEGG data from frozen gson releases and prevents common universe/ID and topology-scope errors.
The graphite relative-name and ENTREZID namespace repair is genuinely executable in the current graphite 1.56.0 runtime.

recommendations.title: Forward n_boot into graphite runSPIA
recommendations.problem: The shipped topology example offers n_boot as its sole performance/reproducibility control but only sends it to direct spia(). The graphite route silently runs 2,000 bootstraps, contradicting the interactive 200-500 guidance and the claimed nB=100 whole-script runtime.
recommendations.root_cause: runSPIA forwards its dots to SPIA::spia, but the example omits nB=n_boot in that call.
recommendations.fix: Change the graphite call to runSPIA(de = de_vec_gr, all = universe_gr, 'kegg_hsa_spia', nB = n_boot), then re-run the topology regression at a reduced documented value and update the reference timing.
